comparison.objective: Secure an anchor line's bitter end and lower the anchor onto a seabed patch; unrelated to damper adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Line fastening, tether management, and controlled lowering versus rigid precision tooling and rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Anchor must reach the blue patch, neither anchor nor line may be lost, and everything must be released. Knot/fastening thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: It tests tethered load handling and loss prevention rather than mechanical commissioning.
